about: Pickett Dummigan Weingart works from Morrison Street in Portland and names twelve people, including the three partners in its name. It publishes in Spanish and calls itself Portland's most experienced injury firm.
Contingency fees and a free consultation, published, along with every trust page pillar D looks for. 90 reviews at 4.8, and a site among the slowest here on Core Web Vitals.
